title: Identifying Hate Speech Peddlers in Online Platforms. A Bayesian Social Learning Approach for Large Language Model Driven Decision-Makers

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates herding behavior (information cascades) in a sequential multi-agent setup where Language-Driven Decision-making Agents (LDDAs) classify hate speech. It measures the threshold at which agents systematically ignore their private textual observations and conform to the public prior, evaluating policies to delay this conformity.
